prompt: A coding agent must make a failing test pass. It can't know in advance how many edits and test runs that will take.
tells: can't know in advance how many edits and test runs
why: Loop: edit, run the tests, read the output, decide what to do next, until they pass.
trap: A fixed chain assumes you know the steps; here each step depends on the last result.

prompt: Answer an open-ended research question by searching, reading results, and deciding what to search next based on what was found.
tells: deciding what to search next based on what was found
why: Act, observe, decide: the core agent loop with search tools.
trap: It uses tools, but the defining feature is the loop deciding its own next step.

prompt: An on-call agent investigates an alert: check logs, form a hypothesis, query metrics, revise, and continue until it finds the cause.
tells: revise, and continue until it finds the cause
why: An open-ended investigation where each observation shapes the next action.
trap: There's one line of investigation here, not separate subtasks to delegate.

prompt: An agent that browses a website to complete a purchase form sometimes keeps clicking forever. You need it to stop after 30 steps or when the goal is met.
tells: stop after 30 steps or when the goal is met
why: Every agent loop needs a stopping condition: goal reached or a step budget.
trap: Sandboxing limits damage, not runaway iteration.
